chunks: By this chain of transmission, from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Isma'il b. Aban al-Azdi informed us. He said: Abdullah b. Khirash al-Shaybani narrated to us from al-Awwam b. Hawshab from al-Taymi. He said: I visited A'isha, and she narrated to us that she saw the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family)
He called Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn (peace be upon them). He said: O Allah, these are my Ahl al-Bayt, so remove uncleanliness from them and purify them with a thorough purification.
ai.seo_question: What did A'isha narrate about the Prophet calling Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn as his Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith records A'isha's eyewitness testimony in which she saw the Prophet (s) gather Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn together and pray for their purification using the words of the Verse of Purification (Quran 33:33). This narration is significant because it comes through A'isha, the Prophet's wife, yet explicitly identifies the Ahl al-Bayt as these four individuals specifically, lending strong support to the Shia understanding that the Ahl al-Bayt in the Quranic verse refers to the household of Ali and Fatima, not the Prophet's wives.

en.bilal-muhammad: By this isnad from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Isma`il b. Aban al-Azdi informed us. He said: `Abdullah b. Khirash al-Shaybani narrated to us from al-`Ulum b. Hushub from al-Taymi. He said: I visited `A’isha, and she narrated to us that she saw the Messenger of Allah (s)
praying for `Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn (as). He was saying: O Allah! These are my Ahl al-Bayt, so remove uncleanliness from them and purify them with a thorough purification.
